notes: 插件更新卡片新增「npm 下载路径」一行，直接显示实际兜底下载地址；GitHub release 整段不通时，更新包自动兜底从 npm 镜像（registry.npmmirror.com）下载，仍按 version.json 里的权威 sha256 校验，换源不放宽校验。实测 npm tarball 与 GitHub release tgz 是同一份产物、sha256 一致。
notesEn: The plugin update card now shows an "npm download URL" line with the actual fallback address. When the GitHub release download is unreachable, the update package automatically falls back to the npm mirror (registry.npmmirror.com), still verified against the authoritative sha256 in version.json — switching source never relaxes verification. The npm tarball is byte-identical to the GitHub release tgz (same sha256).
